hints.title: Dusk
hints.text: The bell has rung. The crew goes to their posts and the dead come, more every night. Press V to see which walls your guns cover, and keep a builder ready to repair (F).

hints.title: Running low
hints.text: Food or water is running low. Select someone, press G and send them scavenging: the houses have food and water. The stores panel shows the days left.

hints.title: Ammo
hints.text: Ammo is running low. Select someone and press M to make more at the worktable from scrap, or send a trip to the hardware store (G).

hints.title: A wound
hints.text: Someone is bleeding. Ana bandages wounds on her own, and each bandage costs one medicine. A bite can also bring a fever: select them and press T.

hints.title: A fever
hints.text: Someone has a fever. Left alone it turns them into one of the dead. Select them and press T to treat it (two medicine), or X to send them out for good.

hints.title: A wall has fallen
hints.text: A wall piece is down and the dead can walk in. Select it and press F to rebuild it, and keep the crew at their posts.

hints.title: Runners
hints.text: Runners are fast and frail: they cross the yard in a few seconds. Keep the guns on the walls they come to, and press V to see where the guns reach.

hints.title: A brute
hints.text: A brute is slow and huge, and it tears walls down. The guns shoot it first. Keep a builder close to mend the wall it attacks (F).

hints.title: Time to build
hints.text: The crew can build now. Press N for the plots: a salvage bench pays for itself.
